bio: By the Nikolaifleet canal, one of the oldest buildings in Hamburg, which is located in the city's oldest street, is home to this appealing bar-cum-restaurant. Spanning a few floors, the space capitalises on the historical charm of the original structure (1697): Crystal chandeliers, wooden beams and modern furnishings as well as shelves lined with decorative bottles all come together to create a genuinely warm ambiance. The kitchen serves its modern take on classic cuisine as a sophisticated set menu or à la carte. Highlights include scallop with barley, salt marsh herbs, apple, seaweed caviar and beurre blanc, or flat iron steak with pumpkin seed dumplings, kalette, mushrooms, apple and cheese.
